cues.speaker: vale
cues.text: Three carrier-wave pings on the maintenance hull. My sister used to tap that exact cadence on the bulkhead pipes when the station power tripped.

cues.speaker: lark
cues.text: You programmed that diagnostic pulse into the entire fleet's emergency transponders, Captain. It could be any survivor in the forward compartment.

cues.speaker: vale
cues.text: Good. Means the auxiliary batteries are still holding life support.

cues.speaker: lark
cues.text: Astra Control. Civilian evacuation corridors are clear. Proceed to jump-coordinates.

cues.speaker: lark
cues.text: They’re spoofing my voice-print on the emergency rescue frequency. Look at the vector—that cruiser has its railguns trained directly on the exit corridor.

cues.speaker: lark
cues.text: Six outer-rim colonies received that false clearance. At 0600, their evacuation transports will burn straight into a kill-box. The Aegis-4 launched ahead of schedule. She took a kinetic round to her main reactor before she could warn the others.

cues.speaker: vale
cues.text: That’s the foundry on Ignis. They forged our hull plating. Right now, the night shift is welding ablative shielding onto civilian freighters while their own dome pressures drop.

cues.speaker: lark
cues.text: Cryo’s neonatal ward lost main heating. They’ve moved the incubators into the geothermal greenhouses to keep the ambient temperature above freezing.

cues.speaker: vale
cues.text: Every one of those chemical flares in the Vespera terminal is a family waiting for a boarding manifest. The grid failed three hours ago, and nobody’s leaving their spot in line.

cues.speaker: lark
cues.text: When the comms array went down, Kharon’s flight director pulled the unindexed dark-space vectors from the local servers. She’s manually flashing the jump coordinates onto the pilots' flight-pads so they don't have to rely on the compromised network.

cues.speaker: lark
cues.text: Tomas. The acoustic signature on that spoofed beacon—it wasn't generated from scratch. They spliced it from the personal clearance I transmitted to your sister’s ship yesterday. I cleared her to launch.

cues.speaker: vale
cues.text: They used your credentials, Lark, not your intent. Stay sharp. We breach the orbital perimeter, scramble their targeting array, and punch a hole through that blockade. Then we escort those transports out—one world at a time.

cues.speaker: lark
cues.text: We have a brief tight-beam window with the Aegis-4 before we hit plasma blackout. What should I transmit?

cues.speaker: vale
cues.text: Two carrier-wave pings. Short and sharp. She knows that means I'm inbound.
